_comment: TOOL is public implementation and documentation.
FIXTURE is synthetic output generated by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA belongs in a verified PRIVATE Git companion, under version control; it is physically absent from this public tool.
_fixture_note: Public test records are generated by tools/make_fixtures.py from independently invented cases.
The boundary check compares generated bytes; case-table review establishes synthetic provenance.
Never hand-edit generated fixtures. Edit cases and run python tools/make_fixtures.py.
_audited: Runtime writes audited: process_account, main, log and summary prove each DATA destination belongs to a PRIVATE Git repository. No source-tree fallback. Runtime state includes unresolved payloads and receipts; these are private versioned DATA.
_data_note: Heartbeat cursors, action ledgers, pending topic headers, summary ledgers, log and pool database resolve from the selected PRIVATE companion.
Relative storage paths resolve from the companion, never cwd. Explicit CLI outputs and log destinations receive the same PRIVATE check.
em_runtime.prove_private rejects public, unknown, unversioned and source-tree destinations before credential or mail access. Normal and linked Git worktrees are supported.
_data_sealed_note: These paths can contain runtime DATA and must not exist in the public source repository.
The seal blocks forced adds as well as ordinary tracked files; gitignore alone is insufficient.
Sealed paths are not public examples and do not require schemas stored beside them.
_data_home: Selected PRIVATE companion; storage defaults are data/state, data/email-monitor.log and data/pool.db beneath it.
